# The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern

> 4-Star Boutique Mountain Hotel, Handcrafted Timber Cottages & Dal View Chalets in Srinagar, Kashmir.

## Identity & Overview
- Name: The Aurum Luxury Collection
- Brand / Operator: Stay Pattern
- Category: Boutique Hotel, Luxury Chalet Resort, Mountain Retreat
- Star Rating: 4-Star
- Location: 23A, Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir 191121, India
- Coordinates: 34.0941256° N, 74.9056223° E
- Official Website: https://aurumhotelskashmir.com

## Accommodation Types
1. Luxury Bedroom Cottage (`/rooms/luxury-bedroom-cottage`): Handcrafted wood-paneled hillside cottage with King bed, climate control heating/AC, en-suite bathroom, and garden/valley views. Max 3 guests.
2. Elegant Chalet Dal View (`/rooms/elegant-chalet-dal-view`): Elevated luxury chalet featuring a private balcony directly facing Dal Lake and the Zabarwan mountains. Max 3 guests.
3. Sunset View Chalet Dal View (`/rooms/sunset-view-chalet-dal-view`): Top-floor master chalet with panoramic windows and balcony offering sunset views over Dal Lake. Max 3 guests.

## Core Amenities & Facilities
- Dining: On-site restaurant serving authentic Kashmiri Wazwan, North Indian cuisine, pure vegetarian options, and halal preparations.
- Room Service: 24-hour in-room dining to cottage or chalet balconies.
- Climate Control: Individual heating and air conditioning units in all rooms.
- Connectivity: Free high-speed Wi-Fi across the property.
- Parking: Free secure private vehicle parking on site.
- Concierge: Airport transfers (SXR), Shikara tour bookings, day trips to Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonamarg.

## Key Distances & Landmarks
- Dal Lake Boulevard: 4.5 km (~10-12 mins)
- Nishat Bagh: 5.2 km (~12 mins)
- Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden: 6.0 km (~15 mins)
- Pari Mahal & Chashme Shahi: 8.5 km (~18 mins)
- Shalimar Bagh: 8.5 km (~18 mins)
- Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport Srinagar (SXR): 22 km (~45 mins)

## Policies
- Check-In: 2:00 PM (14:00)
- Check-Out: 12:00 PM (12:00)
- Identification: Government photo ID required (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License for domestic guests; Passport + Visa/OCI for international visitors).
